rec.name: Highlight Guarantees (Guarantee Card with Social-Proof Footer Bar)
rec.status: Built — delivered; docs revised for non-developer install (Oct 2025)

what.text: A product-page block that renders a card directly under the buy buttons. It has an optional team or founder image (top, left or right), a bold guarantee headline (e.g. '365-day money-back guarantee!'), a short supporting quote or text, and a colored footer bar. The footer bar has a social-proof figure on the left (e.g. '300,000 happy customers') and an underlined link on the right (e.g. 'View reviews').

why.text: Placed right next to the add-to-cart button, the guarantee removes purchase risk at the moment of decision. A real human photo and a founder quote make the promise feel personal and credible. The customer count and review link add social proof and let hesitant buyers verify the claim. Combining risk reversal and social proof in one compact card boosts trust without pushing the buy box down much.

how.text: Build it as a theme block (type 'cro_highlight_guarantees', limit 1) in the product section schema. Steps: (0) duplicate the theme; (1) paste the block JSON into the 'blocks' list in the schema of sections/main-product.liquid (or the theme equivalent); (2) create the snippet cro_highlight_guarantees.liquid with the CSS and markup (thumbnail, main with heading and content, footer with text and link); (3) add a 'case block.type' loop to snippets/product-form.liquid that renders the snippet. Then add the 'CRO | Highlight GTD' block in the theme editor below Buy buttons. With image position left or right, the layout switches to a side-by-side flex layout and the footer stacks vertically. With position top, the image sits above the text and the footer shows text and link side by side.

items: Text color (falls back to the theme text color if transparent)
Thumbnail: image picker, size (Default/Small/Medium/Large; sizes apply when position is Top), position (Top/Left/Right), thumbnail corner radius
Heading (inline rich text) and heading size 14–26px (default 20)
Footer: text size, text color (default #ffffff), background color (default #8782B9), left text, link text, link URL, open in new tab

dependencies.text: Needs a theme with a product section that supports blocks (e.g. main-product.liquid) and a product form snippet where blocks are rendered, plus edit access to the theme code. No app or metafields required. The block is limited to one per section. Uses a theme-level settings.text_color fallback, which may need adapting on themes without it. The original ticket asked for a standalone section with desktop/mobile images, alt text, font controls and a hide toggle, but the delivered build is a PDP block with the settings listed above. Mobile footer stacking applies in the left/right layout.

items: Click-through on the footer 'View reviews' link
Scroll depth and visibility of the buy box area

images.caption: Final UI: team photo on top, guarantee headline with founder quote, and a purple footer bar with '300,000 happy customers' and an underlined 'View reviews' link.
Theme editor: the 'CRO | Highlight GTD' block placed under the Buy buttons on the PDP, with its settings panel (colors, radius, shadow, spacing, thumbnail size/position, heading, content).
